meta.description: Group ratios and privileges for every edition. Billed price = base model price × group ratio.

hero.title: Groups and ratios
hero.subtitle: Every API key is bound to a group. Billed price = base model price × group ratio, with no subscription fees.

ratio.title: How ratios work
ratio.subtitle: The same model costs differently across groups only by its ratio.
ratio.baseNote: The base price is the Personal General group (×1.0) price.

items.q1: How do groups relate to editions?
items.a1: Editions set channel quality and the availability target; groups set which models you can use and at what ratio. Each edition has four groups.
items.q2: Can one account use multiple groups?
items.a2: Yes. Each API key is bound to one group, and one account can create multiple keys for different purposes.
items.a3: Ratio changes are announced on this page in advance; consumption already incurred is not affected.
items.q4: Can organization members choose their own group?
items.a4: Members can only create keys within the group range authorized by the organization admin.
items.q5: How do I enable the Dedicated group?
items.a5: Contact sales — channels, ratios and availability are set by contract.
